description.en: Its distinguishing construction is rounded colony built from tightly packed straight polygonal tubes; retain this geometry rather than treating it as a recolor, scale or pose variant. Original stylized teaching art. Palette, nominal size, pose and simplified details are artistic choices; no scientific reconstruction or coexistence claim.
